slug: 2026-03-04 Ethiopia's approach to use cases shows how to ground data governance in real-world priorities

facts.fact: DIAL reports that health stakeholders in Ethiopia converged on a multi-tenant electronic medical records pilot as the most critical next step to test interoperability, with no launch or go-live stated.

DIAL states that Ethiopia's digital health ecosystem has more than 70 siloed platforms and over 200 pilots, many addressing similar problems without the foundational interoperability needed for seamless service delivery; as_of is the published date, the document giving none.
